title: IGI - SCRABBLING TOURNAMENT
summary: IMPACT GAMES INDIA(IGI) - Scrabbling tournament is an internationally popular mind sport that develops vocabulary, logical thinking, strategy, concentration and confidence and provide an excellent workout for the mind.
description:
IMPACT GAMES INDIA(IGI) - Scrabbling tournament is an internationally popular mind sport that develops vocabulary, logical thinking, strategy, concentration and confidence and provide an excellent workout for the mind. The tournament attracted 40 players. To ensure competitive and enjoyable play, participants were divided into two divisions- A (open) & B (Beginner) with 20 players in each. Every participant played four 40 - minute games, with 20 minutes allotted to each player. Winner in Diviion-A Open - Ms. Carolam Pais-1st and Varishit Hingorani - 2nd . Division -B Beginner - Nikhat Husami - 1st and Rtn. Amish Kapadia - 2nd. The club is proud of Rtn. Amish Kapadia who secured second place in the Beginner Division. His achievement has earned him a place in the competitive journey towards the IGI Finale at NSCI, Andheri on 1st November 2026. The club wishes him every success.
The tournament was managed by Ms. Neeta & Mr. Harry Bhatia of Wordaholix Mindfield LLP.
location: Otters Club, Carter Road, Bandra West, Mumbai - 400050, Maharashtra
